excerpt: Is Birdfy legit? What the smart bird feeder brand sells, what customers say (complaints included), its prices, warranty and returns, and who it suits.

lede: Birdfy makes bird feeders, hummingbird feeders, birdhouses and bird baths with built-in cameras that send clips and alerts to a phone app, sold from birdfy.com. Here's what it sells, what customers say about it, and whether it's worth the money.

parts: Birdfy is a real, established brand. Its About page says it was started in 2020 by the team behind Netvue, a camera maker, and its home page claims more than 2.4 million users. On Trustpilot it held 4.1 out of 5 from 1,777 reviews when we checked, and its best-selling feeders showed 4.7 to 4.8 stars on its own store. Prices run from $99.99 for the basic Birdfy Feeder to $199.99 for the 4K and dual-lens models during the Black Friday sale.

The main line is camera bird feeders: the Birdfy Feeder (the basic model), Feeder Wood, the all-metal Feeder Metal 2 4K and the dual-lens Feeder 2 Pro. There are also two hummingbird feeders (the Hum Feeder and the dual-camera Hum Feeder Duo), the Birdfy Nest birdhouse cameras, the solar-powered Bath Pro bird bath with a fountain, and add-ons such as solar panels, poles, seed guards and perch extensions.

Every device works with the Birdfy app, which sends alerts when a bird lands. Birdfy says its AI bird ID recognizes 6,000+ species and is free with every device; an optional Membership Plus ($79.99) adds longer video storage and other app features.

parts: Recent Trustpilot reviews mostly praise the video quality, easy setup and a helpful support team, and several come from owners buying a second or third device. The complaints we read were about the app and the line-up: one owner found the differences in AI bird ID between models confusing, another said the camera works well only when the bird is close to the lens, and one disliked the cookie and shipping prompts at checkout. Searches for "Birdfy reviews complaints" are common, so read a few low-star reviews for the model you want before you buy.

Yes. birdfy.com publishes its shipping, refund and warranty policies, a US support phone line (Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm Pacific) and live chat, and runs regional stores for the UK, France and Germany. Its large Trustpilot following, with reviews still coming in, also points to a real company shipping real products. As with any sale, the "was" prices are Birdfy's own, so compare the price you pay rather than the percentage off.

If you already feed birds and want to see who visits, the basic Birdfy Feeder at $99.99 is the cheapest way into the brand, and it ships free in the US. The $199.99 models add a sharper camera (the Metal 2 4K) or a second lens (the Feeder 2 Pro). Bird ID comes free, so the app membership is optional. The two-year warranty helps for an outdoor electronic device. Our [Birdfy discount code guide](saving-tips-birdfy-discount-code.html) lists every way to pay less, with prices side by side.

parts: Backyard birders who want photos and clips of their visitors on their phone, families looking for a nature gift, and hummingbird fans who want a closer look. If you only want to feed birds and never watch them on a screen, a plain feeder costs far less.
